definition.alternative: Agents fail to maintain stable objective divergence, collapsing into degenerate state-visitation loops.
assumptions: Dynamic entropy-regulated intrinsic rewards prevent collapse into noise-seeking.
State-space complexity provides adequate substrate for autonomous objective divergence.
definition.falsification: If the adjusted novelty score falls below the required threshold under controlled conditions, the refined hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Autonomous goal formation in reinforcement learning agents occurs when adaptive intrinsic motivation mechanisms dynamically adjust to state-space entropy under strict threshold constraints, resulting in stable, novel objectives that diverge from pure extrinsic optimization.
definition.uncertainty: It remains to be established whether stricter entropy thresholds permanently sustain functional objective emergence without external guidance.

definition.method: Execute a simulation evaluating autonomous goal novelty under an increased entropy threshold of 0.90.
definition.stop: Halt execution if simulated novelty collapses below 0.60.
definition.success: The objective novelty score meets or exceeds 0.75 across all test seeds.
